entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The blue-red guild of Ravnica charged with civic works and magical experiments, led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where the Izzet League operates.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The ancient dragon parun and guildmaster of the Izzet League, said to be the last true dragon; he was slain by Nicol Bolas and later resurrected as the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: In the Echoverse, a spirit dragon and member of the Obzedat who died fighting the nephilim and took a seat on the Ghost Council.

entities.name: Izmundi
entities.description: The servants who make up Niv-Mizzet's court and guide his machinations.

entities.name: Izmagnus
entities.description: The most powerful five to seven members of the Izmundi, Niv-Mizzet's closest advisors.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A blue and red planeswalker born on Ravnica, a high-ranking Izzet guildmage who became acting guildleader and then guildmaster.

entities.name: Melek
entities.description: The Izzet maze runner killed by Ral.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: A goblin courier who served Zomaj Hauc before being chosen and promoted by Niv-Mizzet, and linked to him by the Firemind.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: A mage lord under whom Crix first served.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who slew Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who sabotaged Ral's Guildpact device before Bolas's arrival.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who led the Phyrexian forces against Ravnica and was defeated by Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The guildhall of the Izzet League.

entities.name: Interlocus
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's grand meta-project, an experiment meant to help him absorb the power of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact binding Ravnica's guilds, whose power Niv-Mizzet sought to absorb.

entities.name: Weirds
entities.description: Semi-sentient walking paradoxes created by Niv-Mizzet from elementals of opposing elements, used as lab assistants.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Creatures Niv-Mizzet fought and survived.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's undead army, battled by Ral Zarek and the guilds.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle in which Ral Zarek helped resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Vraska led Phyrexian forces against Ravnica and many Izzet underwent compleation.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild that Echoverse Niv-Mizzet all but bankrupted through life-insurance policies.

events.summary: After fighting with the Nephilim, Niv-Mizzet disappears for a while.
events.quote: After fighting with the Nephilim, Niv-Mizzet was not seen for a while.

events.summary: During his absence Niv-Mizzet uses the Firemind to give guildmages mysterious new projects.
events.quote: During his absence, he used the power of the Firemind to reach out to his guildmages with a complex array of new and mysterious projects for the Izzet League to work on.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet withdraws in secrecy to pursue his research, appointing Ral Zarek acting guildleader.
events.quote: To pursue his research , Niv-Mizzet withdrew in secrecy, appointing Ral Zarek as acting guildleader.

events.summary: Dovin Baan pretends to cooperate with Ral, then sabotages the Guildpact device just before Bolas arrives.
events.quote: but Dovin Baan found out and pretended to cooperate, only to sabotage the device just before Bolas's arrival.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas slays Niv-Mizzet, leaving only his skull and charred bones.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas slew him, leaving behind only his skull and charred bones.

events.summary: Ral Zarek becomes the Izzet's new guildmaster after over 10,000 years.
events.quote: the Izzet League had a new guildmaster, Ral Zarek

events.summary: In the War of the Spark Ral battles the Dreadhorde, unites the guilds and resurrects Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Ral Zarek played a pivotal role in battling the Dreadhorde and uniting the guilds to ultimately resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexian forces against Ravnica but is defeated by Ral Zarek with a sonic weapon.
events.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian forces against Ravnica but was defeated by Ral Zarek with a sonic weapon attuned against the glistening oil .

events.summary: Numerous Izzet willingly undergo compleation out of curiosity, earning distrust from other guilds.
events.quote: numerous Izzet willingly underwent compleation out of sheer curiosity, resulting in great distrust from the other guilds.

events.summary: Ral curtails individual research, sparking intense guild conflict and defections.
events.quote: sparking intense guild conflict and prompting the defection of numerous members.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Niv-Mizzet dies fighting the nephilim, leaving the Izmagnus to run the guild.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the rampaging nephilim not long after Ravnica's decamillennial , leaving his hand-picked Izmagnus to run the Izzet guild in his absence.

events.summary: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet bankrupts the Orzhov Syndicate with life-insurance policies and takes a seat on the Ghost Council.
events.quote: he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.

relations.quote: Founded by parun Niv-Mizzet , an ancient, brilliant, capricious, and narcissistic dragon, the Izzet League continuously creates and destroys and is obsessively driven by a desire for discoveries.

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet created weirds at the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium.
relations.quote: Created during the Katazar-Razblat Elemental Symposium by Niv-Mizzet, weirds are the semi-sentient, walking-paradox result of a fusion of elementals of opposing elements, of fire and water and earth and electricity.
The servants of Niv-Mizzet who make up his court are referred to as the Izmundi .

relations.note: Ral became maze runner after killing Melek.
relations.quote: Ral then takes the role as the Izzet's maze runner after killing Melek .
Ral Zarek is a blue and red-aligned planeswalker, born to the city plane of Ravnica and a high-ranking guildmage to the Izzet League.

relations.note: Chosen and promoted by Niv-Mizzet after serving Zomaj Hauc.
relations.quote: A goblin courier who initially serves under a mage lord Zomaj Hauc but is later chosen, and promoted, by Niv-Mizzet.
Nicol Bolas slew him, leaving behind only his skull and charred bones.

relations.note: Ral defeated Vraska during the invasion.
relations.quote: Vraska led the Phyrexian forces against Ravnica but was defeated by Ral Zarek with a sonic weapon attuned against the glistening oil .
is a blue-red guild from the plane and city of Ravnica .
